scripts.dev: npm run build:types && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @hiflow/api" "npm run dev -w @hiflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build -w @hiflow/api && npm run build -w @hiflow/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @hiflow/api && npm run lint -w @hiflow/web
scripts.test: npm run build:types && npm run test -w @hiflow/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:types && npm run test:e2e -w @hiflow/api
